shinjuku-childcare-facilities.note: Official Shinjuku childcare-facility snapshot data. It does not show vacancies or enrollment status.

shinjuku-evacuation-sites.note: Where to go in an earthquake or fire: the ward's official evacuation site list, ready to link to disaster answers.

shinjuku-public-facilities.note: Ward facilities (offices, halls, libraries) as structured data. The base for “which desk do I go to?” answers.

shinjuku-garbage-sorting.note: Garbage separation rules as data: one of the most-asked daily-life questions in every language.

tokyo-evacuation-shelters.note: Tokyo-wide shelter list with accessibility flags: a cross-check for ward data and the base for expansion.

tokyo-flood-forecast.note: Official flood-risk maps for Tokyo: grounding for disaster-preparedness answers around Shinjuku / Okubo.

tokyo-medical-ledger.note: A structured ledger of medical institutions in a standardized open-data schema. The base for “find care near me”.

tokyo-foreign-population.note: Foreign population by nationality: evidence for which languages MINFO should prioritize, ward by ward.

tokyo-medical-welfare-group.note: The catalog's medical & welfare category: the search path for per-ward clinic and welfare datasets, which vary in naming.

shinjuku-medical-clinics.note: Official Shinjuku City clinic snapshot used by MINFO’s clinic lookup. It is a directory, not live opening or patient-acceptance information.

tokyo-public-schools-2025.note: One official Tokyo source, filtered to Shinjuku, powers MINFO’s elementary, junior-high, and high-school lookups. A listing is not an enrollment or placement guarantee.
